title: LTX 2B 用户认可版本：六例独立测试
selection: Fixed before these tests; same code, weights and profile as the user-accepted eight-case report.
visual_review_method: 16 evenly spaced paired frames, a full-resolution frame-60 pair, and offline step-10 previews; full-video metrics use all 121 frames.

rows.name: 海滩牧羊犬
rows.prompt: A black and white border collie running at an easy pace along a sandy beach near the water. Small waves roll onto the sand as the camera tracks smoothly beside the dog. A single uninterrupted photographic shot with stable framing, consistent natural illumination, clear subject details, coherent movement and realistic textures. No cuts or abrupt camera motion.
rows.visual_observations: 黑白狗的体型、颜色、跟拍构图与行走序列保持；密集帧及主体放大图中能看到连续的四肢动作。个别肢端、尾巴与影子位置有差异，沙地纹理重排、部分细节变软。
rows.visual_assessment: 与已认可天鹅跟拍场景的主体和背景差异性质相近。沙地变化明显，不能视为像素级复原；按用户已认可的主体、动作与整体观感标准保留。

rows.name: 陶艺制作
rows.prompt: A woman in a green sweater turns a pottery bowl slowly on a wheel in a softly lit studio. Her hands guide the wet clay with careful continuous movements. A single uninterrupted photographic shot with stable framing, consistent natural illumination, clear subject details, coherent movement and realistic textures. No cuts or abrupt camera motion.
rows.visual_observations: 陶碗轮廓、人物衣服及扶持动作保持，16 个采样帧中手臂变化大致同步。碗沿、手腕和袖口存在小幅位置差异，毛衣与台面纹理有变化。
rows.visual_assessment: 主要结构和动作保持，局部偏差未显示出比已认可演奏场景更明显的观感退步；保留原始数值未通过记录。

rows.name: 红围巾折叠
rows.prompt: A woman wearing a cream sweater folds a red scarf on a wooden table beside a bright window. Her hands move slowly and continuously, and soft fabric wrinkles follow the motion. A steady medium close-up with realistic detail and consistent sunlight.
rows.visual_observations: 红围巾的颜色、拿起和折叠过程以及明亮窗边构图保持。褶皱排列、衣袖编织纹理和手指局部位置不同，部分细节较软；检查帧中未见主体缺失或大幅结构破坏。
rows.visual_assessment: 与已认可手部场景相同，允许局部纹理和动作相位差异；整体内容和动作仍清楚，按该观感标准保留。

rows.name: 花田小马
rows.prompt: A gray pony walks along a narrow dirt path beside a field of yellow wildflowers. Its mane and tail move softly in a breeze while the camera tracks gently from the side. Continuous realistic shot with natural gait and stable proportions.
rows.visual_observations: 小马轮廓、鬃毛、尾巴及行走到停顿低头的序列保持。四肢局部相位略有不同，大范围花草纹理变化明显，远景部分细节更平滑。
rows.visual_assessment: 主体和动作保持，草地细纹的还原程度不足，严格 SSIM 未达标；按已认可移动动物场景的整体观感标准保留，不宣称无损。

rows.name: 石桥下的船
rows.prompt: A little green rowboat drifts beneath a stone arch bridge on a quiet canal. Reflections of the bridge ripple across the water as the camera moves steadily forward. Soft afternoon sunlight, detailed realistic textures and coherent motion.
rows.visual_observations: 石桥、绿色船只和镜头推进构图保持，16 个采样帧中空间布局稳定。树叶、水面细纹与船内小物细节不同；原生和加速均带一定 CG 感。
rows.visual_assessment: 主要结构和镜头运动与已认可木船场景的要求一致，局部细节差异处于已认可观感范围；数值门槛未通过仍保留。

rows.name: 揉面操作
rows.prompt: A baker wearing a brown apron rolls a small ball of dough across a flour-dusted wooden counter with both hands. The camera stays close at counter height, showing consistent fingers and gentle continuous movement in a bright kitchen.
rows.visual_observations: 揉面姿势、台面与背景构图保持，密集帧中双手动作持续变化。部分帧的手指运动模糊更明显，面粉与面团表面细节有所改变；主体动作仍可辨认。
rows.visual_assessment: 局部手部模糊与已认可小提琴演奏场景的差异性质相近。整体动作和内容保持，按该视觉标准保留；LPIPS 仍未达到原门槛。

early_review: 六例第 10 步的 clean 估计已能辨认主体、场景布局和大致动作：海滩与狗、陶碗与人物、红围巾、小马与花田、石桥与船、双手与面团。恢复预测补入部分沙地、毛衣、花草和建筑纹理；早期手指、毛发及运动边缘仍明显较软，最终自适应刷新进一步补全。全部预览均来自实际测试捕获的 clean 估计，使用配对 VAE 噪声离线解码，在线仅作最终解码。
matched_reference: Same prompt, seed, dimensions, 50 time points and adapted dynamic flow schedule; not the untouched checkpoint schedule.
full_video_location: Server release samples/<test_id>/{native,fast,comparison}.mp4; this supplement contains review stills.
